title: Background Jobs Stopped Being Processed
symptom: Since this morning's release, background jobs pile up and never get processed. The team dashboard shows the worker container as 'running', so everyone assumed the queue itself was broken.

evidence.description: what the container is actually doing

options: The worker is stuck in a restart loop: it exits immediately because /etc/app/config.yml is missing from the new image

debrief: The dashboard said 'running' because with restart=always, Docker restarts the worker the instant it dies — 'docker ps' shows the truth as Restarting, and the restart count was in the hundreds. The logs gave the exact reason: the config file isn't in the new image. A restart policy hides a crash loop unless someone checks restart counts; alert on them. The fix is in the build (the Dockerfile stopped copying the config, or it should come from a mounted volume or env vars), not in restarting anything.
